content:
The audit report failed due to incorrect column headers in the Excel 'Formatted Data' sheet and missing priority session details in the Word summary.
In test_formatted_data_logic, index 7 of the headers was 'Count Qty' instead of the required 'Missing Final Count'. The Word document verifier test_word_summary_content failed with 'assert 0 >= 2' because it could not find at least two high-priority facility-session combinations in the text. While 4 tests passed, the audit results failed to populate the summary and formatted sheets with the specific logic expected by the legacy pytest suite in /tests/test_outputs.py.
